loading.text: Sorting the urgent from the not-so-urgent…
Hang on… I know someone who’s gonna wait.

profileCreated.title: You’re all set, {{name}}!
profileCreated.body: Your profile is live. Now let the jobs come to you, no chasing needed.

success.jobDeclined: No problem. We’ll keep looking for something that suits you better.
success.applicantAccepted: Done. {{name}} gets a message in seconds.
success.applicantDeclined: Declined kindly. We’ll let {{name}} know there’s more work coming.

all.title: All caught up.
all.body: Nothing new right now. We’ll shout if something important comes in.

urgent.title: Nothing urgent. Enjoy your chai.
urgent.body: When something can’t wait, you’ll know straight away, even by SMS.

medium.title: Nothing here for now.
medium.body: Messages and updates will show up here.

low.title: Quiet day.
low.body: Small updates wait here until your daily summary.

spam.workerLine: {{count}} scam messages tried to reach you. They didn’t get past us.
spam.adminBlocked: Blocked. That one won’t bother anyone again.

admin.priorityCorrected: Noted. The model will learn from this one.

offline.title: You’re offline. Don’t worry.
offline.body: Urgent alerts will still reach you by SMS, so you won’t miss a thing. We’ll catch up the moment you’re back.

notFound.title: This page went for lunch and didn’t come back.
notFound.body: Let’s get you somewhere more useful.

error.title: Something tripped on our side.
error.body: It’s us, not you. Give it another go, and if it keeps happening, we’re already on it.

landing.ctaSub: That’s less time than waiting for a matatu to fill up.
landing.footer: Made in Nairobi, powered by a lot of chai.
